title: Stephanie L NDE 9327
content: I lost consciousness and passed out from lack of oxygen. I woke up in white void. There were no ground or physical objects. I felt like I had been having philosophical conversations with an unseen man. He had a reassuring voice that made me feel no doubt or fear. It felt like I was there a very long time. I was interrupted by him and the only words I remember were him telling me “You need to wake up right now, it will be beautiful.” I asked him to repeat what he said and he did. At that point, I realized I was in an out of Body experience and needed to return so I did so with urgency. I instantly woke up and sat up straight to throw up. I asked my friends how long I was out and they said about a minute, but in my head I felt like it was a very long time. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 2002 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Accident Drug or medication overdose Blowing fire with inhaled computer duster Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? No I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal No distractions. I was solely focused on the experience. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When the voice of the man instructed me to wake up Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual Time was slow Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Felt like a dream and I woke up in it Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Telepathy. I could hear fine but we did not speak words. It was all in the mind. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Completely pure white environment with nothing physical in it Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. Pure white environment that seemed like open space What emotions did you feel during the experience? Curiosity. Followed by anxiety because I needed to wake up. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life. I was instructed to wake up and I felt it was important to do so God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Do not know Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes More open minded about supreme beings existence in our after life What is your religion now? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Secular unaffiliated Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I heard a voice. I could not identify. Only the calm voice of a man I have never heard or met before Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes The man I was speaking to seemed to have wisdom During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes I spoke to a man who seemed intellectual. He was only a voice but unlike anything else and it felt like he knew me. I think he was a supreme being who gave me a reality check Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I felt like the man and I had deep conversations but I can't remember them During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists Uncertain Yes, a life made of energy with no physical restrictions Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life More mindful about remembering that we all have a purpose on earth Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience less accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

arrival.other_being_detail: Unseen man/voice; calm and reassuring; described as a man she had never heard/met; felt wise and seemed to know her; she thought he might be a supreme being.

environment.environment_other_detail: White void; pure white open space with no ground or physical objects.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Instructed by the unseen man/voice to wake up; felt it was important and returned urgently.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Loss of consciousness from lack of oxygen while blowing fire with inhaled computer duster (drug/medication overdose noted).

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Prior: 'Do not know'. Current: secular unaffiliated.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: White void; philosophical/telepathic conversation with an unseen man/voice; instruction to wake up; urgent return and instant awakening.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel and no described OBE separation; experience begins with awakening into a white void, then communication, then instruction/decision to return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience described as waking up into a pure white void with no ground/objects; 'philosophical conversations' with an unseen man; instruction: “You need to wake up right now, it will be beautiful.”
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “You need to wake up right now, it will be beautiful.”
